parameters.kill_gap_note: gaps are drawn once per trial from random.Random(seed * 1000 + trial), so both arms of a trial get the same planned schedule; the first kill waits for the first SUCCESSFUL row; kills stop once READY is 0
parameters.restart_policy: no supervisor in either arm; the harness starts a replacement worker with the same command immediately after each kill

ox.reclaim_bound_note: a stranded row's lease expires at most LOCK_TIMEOUT after its last renewal; the replacement worker's reaper runs on its poll loop every reap interval; so a reclaim is expected within LOCK_TIMEOUT + reap interval + poll interval of the kill, and the idle and observation windows together exceed that bound
